projects.title: fibtransponder: Fibonacci Streaming State Machine
projects.description: An experimental tokenization and semantic sensing substrate built around a Fibonacci-radix streaming state machine (FSVM). Evaluates bounded per-step work bitstream ingestion, structural calibration via adjacency width, and Zobrist hash seed tables.
projects.impact: Demonstrated that structural adjacency width acts as a locality-sensitivity selector; falsified seed-only detector diversity through automated corpus benchmarks.
highlights: Canonical thesis: structural calibration via adjacency width is demonstrated; width selects locality sensitivity
Corpus falsification: proved that seed-only Zobrist calibration does not create detector diversity
Sensitivity shift: varying adjacency width triggers a demonstrable prose-first to code-first transition

projects.title: Multi-Host Declarative NixOS Infrastructure
projects.description: Production-grade, fully reproducible multi-host fleet (NAS, workstations, cloud endpoints) managed with Nix Flakes. Features a custom SSH Certificate Authority with automated rotation, age/SOPS secret encryption, automated self-upgrades, and a Taskfile control plane.
projects.impact: Zero manual server configuration. One-command host commissioning, automated morning kernel boot validation, and air-gapped secret hygiene.
highlights: Zero manual server configuration or configuration drift
Short-lived SSH certificates instead of authorized_keys clutter
ZFS/Btrfs storage, ZRAM tmpfs IO diet, and hermetic CI/CD automation

projects.title: Bountystash: Deterministic Work Engine
projects.description: Thin, server-rendered Go application turning unstructured task requirements into immutable, content-addressed specifications. Features append-only event sourcing, a keyboard-first terminal UI, and curl-friendly endpoints.
projects.impact: Single-binary deployment, sub-millisecond route resolution, zero frontend dependencies, and deterministic audit trail.
highlights: Single-binary deployment with sub-millisecond route resolution
Content hashes and projection quotient hashes for tamper-evident versioning
Dual surface: markdown for agents, clean HTML for browsers, TUI for humans

projects.title: Deterministic Typst Resume Engine
projects.description: A local build pipeline compiling structured JSON into pixel-perfect A4 PDFs with Typst. Enforces geometric typographic ratios (φ = 1.61803) with sub-second compilation, replacing LaTeX and browser-based PDF toolchains.
projects.impact: One source of truth across the PDF resume, cover letters and this site; hermetic compilation with no runtime Node.js and no headless browser.
highlights: One source of truth across the PDF resume, cover letters, and the web portfolio
Hermetic compilation without runtime Node.js or browser headless overhead

philosophy.title: Reproducibility is non-negotiable
philosophy.body: If an infrastructure state, document build, or service binary cannot be built deterministically from code, it doesn't truly exist. Declarative NixOS flakes and locked dependencies prevent an entire class of production failures.

philosophy.title: Domain depth beats generic engineering
philosophy.body: Writing code is only half the battle. Understanding financial yield formulas, physical energy systems, or bitstream locality sensitivity prevents architectural mistakes before the first line of SQL is written.

philosophy.title: Keep the runtime lightweight
philosophy.body: Low-latency systems come from sensible fundamentals: compiled Go services, clean data models, server-rendered layouts, and respecting network envelopes like the 14KB rule.
